backup_destination_kind_shape.name: backup_destination_kind_shape
backup_destination_kind_shape.value:
("backup_destination"."kind" = 's3' and "backup_destination"."provider" is not null and "backup_destination"."endpoint" is not null
             and "backup_destination"."region" is not null and "backup_destination"."bucket" is not null
             and "backup_destination"."access_key_enc" is not null and "backup_destination"."secret_key_enc" is not null
             and "backup_destination"."server_id" is null
             and (("backup_destination"."age_recipient" is null and "backup_destination"."age_identity_enc" is null)
               or ("backup_destination"."age_recipient" is not null and "backup_destination"."age_identity_enc" is not null)))
          or ("backup_destination"."kind" = 'server' and "backup_destination"."server_id" is not null and "backup_destination"."age_recipient" is not null
             and "backup_destination"."age_identity_enc" is not null and "backup_destination"."bucket" is null
             and "backup_destination"."access_key_enc" is null and "backup_destination"."secret_key_enc" is null)

backups_target_kind_xor.name: backups_target_kind_xor
backups_target_kind_xor.value:
("backups"."target_kind" = 'database' and "backups"."database_id" is not null and "backups"."app_id" is null)
          or ("backups"."target_kind" = 'app' and "backups"."app_id" is not null and "backups"."database_id" is null)

cron_jobs_target_kind_xor.name: cron_jobs_target_kind_xor
cron_jobs_target_kind_xor.value:
("cron_jobs"."target_kind" = 'app' and "cron_jobs"."app_id" is not null and "cron_jobs"."database_id" is null)
          or ("cron_jobs"."target_kind" = 'database' and "cron_jobs"."database_id" is not null and "cron_jobs"."app_id" is null)
